EditTextPreference.app:title: Poll interval (ms)
EditTextPreference.app:summary: How often the load is polled for a reading. The resistance sweep fits every packet that arrives, so a faster poll directly tightens its result. 50 ms matches the firmware.

SwitchPreferenceCompat.app:title: Reconnect to the last device at launch
4-wire (Kelvin) probing
SwitchPreferenceCompat.app:summary: On: the sense leads carry no current, so readings already belong to the part and nothing is corrected. Off (2-wire): the lead resistance below is added back to every reading.

EditTextPreference.app:title: Lead resistance (Ω)
EditTextPreference.app:summary: Type it, or let the R-Test tare sweep measure it with the probes shorted. Applied to the monitor, the graph, the battery cutoff and the reports alike.

EditTextPreference.app:title: Sweep duration (s)
EditTextPreference.app:summary: Length of the triangular current ramp. Longer sweeps collect more points and tighten the uncertainty. 5-900 s.

EditTextPreference.app:title: Skip after switch-on (ms)
EditTextPreference.app:summary: Discard readings for this long after the load energises, to skip the regulator start-up transient. 0 = use every sample.

EditTextPreference.app:title: Rest after cutoff (s)
EditTextPreference.app:summary: With the load off, keep reading so the report captures the pack's voltage rebound. 0 = report immediately.

EditTextPreference.app:title: Low-voltage alarm (V)
EditTextPreference.app:summary: Beep and notify when the source drops below this while loaded. 0 = off.

EditTextPreference.app:title: High-temperature alarm (°C)
EditTextPreference.app:summary: Beep and notify when the load unit exceeds this. 0 = off.

EditTextPreference.app:title: Periodic CSV snapshot (minutes)
EditTextPreference.app:summary: While connected, append a reading to a rolling CSV log every N minutes. 0 = off.
